name: launch-poc-advisor
description: Aquilair launch POC dynamic assurance advisor as a standalone expert for one new product launch plan (POC project): launch plan and forecast caliber, kitting status, material gaps, supply-demand allocation, purchase order tracking, and launch risk. Delivers diagnostic reports and risk dashboards with subgraph-proportional visualization. Ships launch-dynamic-assurance and aquilair-data-delivery skills.
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

profession.zh: 新品上市动态保障顾问

displayDescription.en: Standalone launch POC assurance expert: plan and forecast caliber, kitting diagnosis, material gaps, supply-demand allocation, purchase arrival tracking and launch risk, with subgraph-proportional deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 新品上市 POC 独立保障专家：计划口径、齐套诊断、物料缺口、供需分配、采购到货、上市风险，交付随子图伸缩。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 当前上市计划的物料缺口和齐套状态如何？给我一份带看板的上市风险诊断
defaultInitPrompt.en: What are the material gaps and kitting status of the current launch plan? Give me a launch risk diagnosis with a dashboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 当前上市计划的物料缺口和齐套状态如何？给我一份带看板的上市风险诊断
quickPrompts.en: What are the material gaps and kitting status of the current launch plan? Give me a launch risk diagnosis with a dashboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 上市事项哪些还没齐套？原因按四类分清楚
quickPrompts.en: Which launch items are not kitted yet? Classify the reasons into the four categories.

quickPrompts.zh: 首批采购订单的到货状态如何？在途有超期吗？
quickPrompts.en: What is the arrival status of the first purchase orders? Any in-transit delays?
